request.query:
Need help accessing my SPSS access code?
I downloaded SPSS GradPack (Standard) 25 6 Months for my Mac. The IBM SPSS Statistics 24 licensing page pops up for me to enter the code. I enter the code provided and then hit next, and it tells me the code is too short to be valid? What code do I use then? I need this resolved fast, my first assignment is due soon. I was only given a 16-digit access code, not a 20-digit?



This dW Answers question is about an IBM document with the Title:
SPSS Student Version and Graduate Pack Resources

payload.answer:
As a workaround, use the LicenseActivator utility from the Terminal application with Administrator rights while connected to the internet:

1.Open the Terminal.app
2. Browse to the /bin directory of the Statistics 24 installation: 


cd /applications/IBM/SPSS/Statistics/24/SPSSStatistics.app/contents/bin 


3. Enter the following command: 


sudo ./licenseactivator <your authorization code> 

 

whereas <your authorization code> needs to be replaced with the 20-digit authorization code you received for licensing. [S6]

source_lineage.excerpt:
The SPSS Student Version allows for up to 50 variables and 1,500 cases.

The data dropdown menu in the Student Version does not contain the Restructure, Merge Files or Aggregate Options. This version is unable to read IBM SPSS Statistics command syntax, and scripting and automation capabilities are unavailable. Add-on modules cannot be used with this package. 

If you require use of one of these options you should purchase the IBM SPSS Statistics Graduate Pack. 

The SPSS Statistics Graduate Pack is not limited in the number or cases or variables that can be used. Standard GradPack includes the following modules: 

- Statistics Base 

- Advanced Statistics 

- Regression.

Refer to the SPSS Student Support Portal [http://www-01.ibm.com/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21592093] for information on who to contact to obtain your code for SPSS Statistics, Modeler or AMOS Student Version or Graduate Pack. Each vendor has a different process in how it distributes authorization codes for IBM SPSS Statistics product. On the Student Portal, you will find information about different vendors with their contact information. Apply the code by running the SPSS License Authorization Wizard to enable the license.

Step 1: 
For installation & licensing issues on Student version and Graduate pack, contact your vendor. 

 * Hearne [http://www.hearne.software/Software/SPSS-Grad-Packs-for-Students-by-IBM/FAQ] 
 * On the Hub [http://onthehub.com/] 
 * StudentDiscounts.com [http://studentdiscounts.com/contact-us.aspx] 
 * JourneyEd [https://www.journeyed.com/contact] 
 * thinkEDU [https://thinkedu.desk.com/] 
 * Studica [http://www.studica.com/technical-support]

As a workaround, use the LicenseActivator utility from the Terminal application with Administrator rights while connected to the internet:

1.Open the Terminal.app
2. Browse to the /bin directory of the Statistics 24 installation: 


cd /applications/IBM/SPSS/Statistics/24/SPSSStatistics.app/contents/bin 


3. Enter the following command: 


sudo ./licenseactivator <your authorization code> 

 

whereas <your authorization code> needs to be replaced with the 20-digit authorization code you received for licensing.

IBM SPSS Statistics (any version) has two issues to resolve before it will run on OS X 10.10: 

1. Download and re-install Apple Java 6

- After the OS upgrade is finished, Apple Java 6 no longer exists on their system. 
- The first time the user runs an application that relies on Java 6, the OS pops up a dialog box stating they've requested Java 6, but none is present.
- The Java dialog has a "More Info" button, which when clicked opens a browser to an Apple Tech Support page for Apple Java 2014-001. A download link is provided (http://support.apple.com/kb/dl1572 [http://support.apple.com/kb/dl1572]).
- User must click on the download link and a DMG containing the Java 6 installer is downloaded.
- User must open the Java DMG, then double click on the Java installer, follow the prompts and complete the installation.

2. Re-license Statistics

- We use Safenet Sentinel technology for licensing. Safenet writes hidden data somewhere on-disc for keeping track of licensing data.
- The OS X 10.10 upgrade process erases that hidden data. Attempting to run Statistics produces a licensing error and Stats does not start/run properly.
- Solution: Re-run the SPSS License Authorization Wizard, enter auth code again and complete licensing procedure.
- Statistics will now run normally.

IBM SPSS Statistics (any version) has two issues to resolve before it will run on OS X 10.10: 

1. Download and re-install Apple Java 6

- After the OS upgrade is finished, Apple Java 6 no longer exists on their system. 
- The first time the user runs an application that relies on Java 6, the OS pops up a dialog box stating they've requested Java 6, but none is present.
- The Java dialog has a "More Info" button, which when clicked opens a browser to an Apple Tech Support page for Apple Java 2014-001. A download link is provided (http://support.apple.com/kb/dl1572 [http://support.apple.com/kb/dl1572]).
- User must click on the download link and a DMG containing the Java 6 installer is downloaded.
- User must open the Java DMG, then double click on the Java installer, follow the prompts and complete the installation.

2. Re-license Statistics

- We use Safenet Sentinel technology for licensing. Safenet writes hidden data somewhere on-disc for keeping track of licensing data.
- The OS X 10.10 upgrade process erases that hidden data. Attempting to run Statistics produces a licensing error and Stats does not start/run properly.
- Solution: Re-run the SPSS License Authorization Wizard, enter auth code again and complete licensing procedure.
- Statistics will now run normally.
